claim: Before another 303M run, test whether preserving every eligible reviewed human assistant turn inside the canonical causal window supplies a learnable conversation support set, and whether the existing response-CE treatment improves prompt-conditioned generation over the matched base-CE control.

fixed_source.eligibility: reviewed, non-deleted, non-synthetic human messages with alternating prompter/assistant ancestry
fixed_source.panel_contamination: fail closed on exact prompt occurrence

single_variable_data_test.control: existing one-best-path-per-root documents; complete documents longer than 513 bytes are ineligible
single_variable_data_test.treatment: every eligible assistant turn rendered with the longest complete alternating ancestry suffix that fits 513 bytes; no byte truncation and no partial role or response

tiny_model_test.device: local Apple MPS with at most two CPU threads; Vast.ai only if local MPS is unavailable

data_views.selection: documents are already ordered by SHA-256; take the first N without result-dependent curation
data_views.generation_probe_selection: the first eight of the 100 SHA-ordered training documents containing exactly one canonical user turn and one canonical assistant turn

training.schedule: 50-step linear warmup then cosine to 0.1 peak ratio

arms.V2: same base CE plus existing answer_ce weight 1.0 on all canonical assistant spans

diagnostic_gates.single_document_overfit: both arms must reproduce the registered assistant response exactly after canonical turn parsing
diagnostic_gates.hundred_document_descent: both arms must end below their own initial held-out dialogue CE
diagnostic_gates.prompt_conditioning: on the first eight deterministic training prompts, at least 6/8 responses must be non-empty and at least six normalized responses must be distinct
diagnostic_gates.target_recovery: at least 6/8 generated turns must share the first 16 UTF-8 bytes of their registered training response
diagnostic_gates.structural: all eight generated responses must avoid next-user role leakage, invalid UTF-8 and a repeated phrase occupying three consecutive clauses

tiny_model_test.selection_rule: V2 advances only if it passes every diagnostic gate and its final held-out dialogue CE is no more than V0 final CE + 0.02; otherwise neither arm authorizes 303M

promotion.303m_single_seed: allowed only after every data gate and one tiny arm pass
promotion.303m_multi_seed: locked until a separately preregistered 303M single-seed meaningful-conversation pass

failure_policy.if_data_gate_fails: record failure and do not rent GPU
failure_policy.if_tiny_gate_fails: record failure, upload data evidence if created, delete GPU, and do not run 303M
failure_policy.if_303m_screen_fails: record and upload raw artifacts; do not extend, sweep, deploy, or start R1
